entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: Challenge completed with a result[n]to be proud of.
entries.uk: Випробування пройдено з результатом,[n]яким можна пишатися.

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Could've been better, but I'll throw[n]you a bone.
entries.uk: Могло бути й краще, але так і буть,[n]кину тобі кістку.

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: I can't believe you've come so far...[n]Most impressive! Well do—

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: I mean— Don't let it go to your head!

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: All this work is for the sake of your[n]rehabilitation—and don't forget it![n]You'd BETTER keep up the hard work!

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: You have displayed such incredible[n]aptitude—far beyond our expectations.

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: Witnessing such results is gratifying[n]to ourselves as well, having assembled[n]this training regiment for you.

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: Continue to grow and reach new[n]heights... Don't disappoint us,[n]Inmate.

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: I didn't expect you to trounce[n]such a formidable opponent...

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: Does that mean that you even surpass[n]the heroes of the past!?

entries.speaker: Caroline
entries.en: *chuckle* Interesting... Use that power[n]in your rehabilitation, Inmate!

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: So you have even surpassed another[n]who holds the power of the wild card...[n]A truly impressive feat.

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: Perhaps you too aim to become a hero[n]who overcomes fate itself?

entries.speaker: Justine
entries.en: Continue with your rehabilitation and[n]resist the approaching ruin... Don't[n]disappoint us, Inmate.
